title: Email uniqueness enforcement during registration
gherkin:
Feature: Unique email address
  Scenario: User attempts to register with a unique email address
    Given the user provides a unique email address
    When the user submits the registration form
    Then the registration should be successful
    And the email address should be stored as unique
rationale: To ensure that the system allows registration only when the email address is unique, thus fulfilling the requirement.
usedContextItems: Instead of enforcing strict email uniqueness, we may allow multiple accounts to share the same email if another identifier (such as phone number) is unique.
